description: A web-based interface for visualizing and browsing database structures and data, including dynamic loading of databases, tables, and table data. Features include refreshing database list, expanding cell content, and responsive design.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases from the backend API and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list, resets current selections, and updates the UI accordingly.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Handles expanding or collapsing the database's list of tables upon user interaction.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Loads tables of the selected database from the backend API and displays them in the sidebar.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays table data for the selected table, limiting to 50 records.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders the fetched table data into an HTML table within the container.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates individual table cell HTML, handling nulls, objects, and long content appropriately, with expand/collapse functionality.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses a cell's content to show full data or truncated preview.
